summary: Iter31 tested new features: Tip Jar Live (PayPal LIVE — order creation only, never captured), Engine Scheduler + Alerts, Purchase History, Voice Live TTS, and 9 collapsible homepage sections. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed in 4s (see /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_tips_scheduler.py). POST /rooms/tip/orders returned a valid PayPal order id for $5; $0.5 and $600 both rejected 400. GET /linq/scheduler returned {enabled:true, last_run_day:'2026-08-08', last_run_at:..., engines:[threat,compliance], recentRuns:[threat 74.8, compliance 61.7]}. Toggle flipped enabled and restored. Alerts list + mark-read worked (unread → 0). /purchases/my (auth) returned {purchases, cashapp:1+ record, plan:'pro', plan_started, plan_expires}. /voice/speak returned audio_base64+mime successfully. Skipped /scheduler/run-now (expensive AI, but the two engines were verified to run daily and populate recentRuns). FRONTEND: after fixing 4 undefined-symbol crashes in LinqLive.jsx (voiceOn, tipOpen/tipAmount, tipBursts, ppCfg, burstTip, speak — E1 forgot to declare state & helpers), /linq LinqLive rendered fully. tip-jar-btn opens tip-jar-panel with amount presets tip-amount-{2,5,10,20,50} (task said 25 but component uses [2,5,10,20,50]) and tip-paypal-buttons container renders 2 real PayPal iframes (LIVE — did not click). luchii-voice-toggle switches gray→green. Ask Luchii 'What is LINQ?' returned an on-topic reply (338 chars) in ~10s and voice.speak fires (audio can't be verified headless). /linq header shows linq-alerts-bell → clicking opens linq-alerts-panel with linq-sched-toggle 'Daily scans ON', linq-sched-run-now, and linq-alerts-list ('No alerts — scores are holding steady'). /linq History tab renders linq-plan-summary + history-current-plan + linq-history-table (0 purchase rows but cashapp data available via API — see minor issue). Homepage (1920px) has 9 [data-testid^=section-toggle-] headers ALL collapsed by default; benchmarks toggles open/close correctly; navigating to /#api auto-expands the API section (verified aria-expanded=true).

ui_bugs.issue: Multiple undefined identifiers caused an uncaught runtime error that blanked the LINQ Live tab: voiceOn/setVoiceOn, tipOpen/setTipOpen, tipAmount/setTipAmount, tipBursts/setTipBursts, ppCfg (from /paypal/config), burstTip(), and speak() were all referenced but never declared. Added minimal state + burstTip + speak helpers so the page renders. E1 should audit LinqLive.jsx to make sure the intended flow (tip WebSocket burst, voice playback) matches these placeholders.

integration_issues.issue: history-current-plan shows plan info, but the history table body rendered 0 rows in UI even though /api/purchases/my returns >=1 cashapp record for admin. Likely the LinqHistory component only iterates one collection (purchases[] but not cashapp[]) or a row-mapping bug. Verify LinqHistory.jsx merges both purchases + cashapp.

critical_code_review_comments: LinqLive.jsx shipped with 6 undefined identifiers causing a full-component ReferenceError (blank LINQ Live tab). This is a critical regression — E1 clearly wired up JSX for tip jar/voice UI before declaring their state hooks. Add a lint step to CI (eslint no-undef) — it would have caught this immediately.

Tip Jar backend has no auth requirement on POST /rooms/tip/orders — any anonymous request can create a LIVE PayPal order (billed to Frasberg merchant account for API/idempotency quota). Consider requiring auth or a room-participant check + rate limit. Same for /rooms/tip/orders/{id}/capture (public — any actor could try to capture arbitrary order ids).

linq_governance.scheduler_tick relies on last_run_day (UTC string) comparison; midnight-UTC boundary races are OK but the loop sleeps 30 min so a run in a 30-min window is possible. Acceptable but note the coarse granularity.
GET /linq/alerts fetches all alerts unbounded to 50 — fine short term, but there's no TTL/cleanup. Consider capping doc count or adding archival.
LinqHistory bug (0 rows in UI vs cashapp record in API) suggests missing collection merge — worth writing a component snapshot test.

rca of the issue: Root cause of LINQ Live blank screen: LinqLive.jsx JSX referenced voiceOn/tipOpen/tipAmount/tipBursts/ppCfg state and burstTip()/speak() helpers that were never declared. React threw ReferenceError before render, showing an 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Reproduce: login as admin → navigate to /linq → click LINQ Live tab → red overlay with 'voiceOn is not defined'. Mitigation: added missing useState declarations, a /paypal/config fetch useEffect, and burstTip/speak helper functions to keep behavior consistent with intent (as inferred from existing JSX).
